note: WAEC Geography round 6 (R29 top-up): equator great circle, meridian convergence, Date Line day arithmetic, grid reference, contour interval, legend; core, mantle, fossils in sedimentary; freeze-thaw, attrition, mushroom rock; lava plateau; convectional rain on Jos highlands, rain shadow; xerophytes, pneumatophores; catena, grass waterways; brain drain, dispersed settlement, slums; oil palm east, Niger Delta oil, Kainji on the Niger, limestone for cement, Lokoja confluence; Lake Chad's shrinkage, desertification, monsoon winds' cause. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-5, NECO Geography (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
